description: E8 one curator: a run started in the background holds the lock while its lint model step works (on a memory link only the model can repair), so a second run started meanwhile returns at once with already running; a machine not named in store.json refuses without writing the run record; curate take-over names it, after which it runs, and the machine named before stops at its preflight. Exactly one run happens each time.

steps.stdout: \Aa curation run started in the background

run: until m2b status --json | grep -q '"state": "running"'; do sleep 0.1; done

steps.stdout: \Aa curation run is already running on this machine\n\Z

run: until m2b status --json | grep -q '"state": "succeeded"'; do sleep 0.1; done

steps.stdout: \Athis machine \(sb-test-other\) is not the curating machine; sb-test-e2e is
\Athis machine \(sb-test-other\) curates the store now; sb-test-e2e stops at its next run\.\n\Z
\Athis machine \(sb-test-e2e\) is not the curating machine; sb-test-other is
